; docformat = 'rst' ;+ ; ; ; :Categories: ; ; CRISP pipeline ; ; ; :Author: ; ; ; ; ; :Returns: ; ; ; :Params: ; ; cub : ; ; ; ; ; :Keywords: ; ; ; ; :History: ; ; 2013-06-04 : Split from monolithic version of crispred.pro. ; ; ;- function red_get_cross, cub inam = 'get_red_cross : ' stkname = ['I', 'Q', 'U', 'V'] crt = fltarr(4) crt[0] = median(cub[*,*,0]) for ii = 1, 3 do begin tmp = red_fillnan(reform(cub[*,*,ii]) / cub[*,*,0]) me = median(tmp) mask = abs(tmp-me) LE (2.0 * stddev(tmp)) idx = where(mask, count) if(count ge 1) then begin crt[ii] = mean(tmp[idx]) if(~finite(crt[ii])) then crt[ii] = median(tmp[idx]) endif else begin crt[ii] = mean(tmp) if(~finite(crt[ii])) then crt[ii] = median(tmp[idx]) print, inam + 'WARNING, something could be wrong with I -> '+stkname[ii]+' = ' + crt[ii] endelse endfor ; ii return, crt end
